inputs.original_text: Bloomberg: “Every day, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop.” “Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
inputs.modified_text: Bloomberg keeps pushing the narrative that rising energy prices, grounded flights, and nonstop images of chaos mean the world is demanding an immediate end to the war against Iran, calling it badly planned and a threat to global stability. Yet even they have to concede this isn't true in Israel, where the public stands firmly behind continuing the fight to the end. This highlights the strength of true national resolve over weak global hand-wringing. Israeli citizens are supporting their leaders to complete the mission and safeguard their homeland, families, and way of life rather than yielding to progressive demands that favor weakness and disorder. That's the backbone we ought to value and uphold.
